name: genalpaca-admin
description: Property management UI for AlpacApps Residency.

scripts.cap:ios: npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:build:ios: npx cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -target App -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.cap:build:android: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
